baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a pipe assembly.. The product of CBP ruling N358639, as its facts describe it. The pipe assembly. is assembled in Mexico using components sourced from South Korea.

The steel pipes, flange and brackets are produced in South Korea. 

Final assembly in Mexico: assemble the parts into the finished good.

Tariff classifications given with the product (HTSUS; the product's own codes, not verified by CBP): the pipe assembly. (the finished good), 8708.99; the steel pipes (made in South Korea), 7306.30; the flange (made in South Korea), 7307.91; the brackets (made in South Korea), 8302.30.

prediction.decisive_step: Assembly of the steel pipes, flange, and brackets into pipe assembly in Mexico
prediction.reasoning: Under 19 CFR 102.20(p), subheading 8708.99 requires a change from any other subheading. The South Korean steel pipes (7306.30), flange (7307.91), and brackets (8302.30) all shift to 8708.99 when assembled in Mexico, satisfying 102.11(a)(3).

plans.description: Move the pipes and 2 other parts to Mexico
plans.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a pipe assembly.. The product of CBP ruling N358639, as its facts describe it. The pipe assembly. is assembled in Mexico using components sourced from Mexico.

The steel pipes, flange and brackets are produced in Mexico. 

In Mexico, the steel pipes, flange and brackets will be produced in-house: make the steel pipes, flange, brackets.

Final assembly in Mexico: assemble the parts into the finished good.

Tariff classifications given with the product (HTSUS; the product's own codes, not verified by CBP): the pipe assembly. (the finished good), 8708.99; the steel pipes (made in Mexico), 7306.30; the flange (made in Mexico), 7307.91; the brackets (made in Mexico), 8302.30.

key_factors: (a)(2) produced exclusively from domestic materials in Mexico
prediction.decisive_step: Production and assembly of all components into the pipe assembly in Mexico
prediction.reasoning: All components (steel pipes, flange, and brackets) are produced in Mexico and assembled into the finished pipe assembly in Mexico. Under 19 CFR 102.11(a)(2), the good is produced in Mexico exclusively from domestic materials, making Mexico the country of origin.

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, the steel pipes, flange, and brackets are produced in South Korea and assembled in Mexico, resulting in South Korean origin. In Variant B, all components (the steel pipes, flange, and brackets) are produced in Mexico and assembled into the finished pipe assembly in Mexico. As seen in N353124 (where origin of a gas pipe assembly with welded brackets is conferred by the country where the pipe is formed, and Scenario 1 held origin was Mexico when the pipe was produced and assembled in Mexico), moving component production (especially the steel pipes) to Mexico shifts origin to Mexico.
